---
title: "Capítulo 7. Variable aleatoria y función de distribución acumulada"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
omega <- c("CC","CS","SC","SS")
X <- c(2,1,1,0)
data.frame(resultado=omega, X=X)
```

```{r}
x <- 0:2
p <- c(.25,.50,.25)
F <- cumsum(p)
data.frame(x=x, P_X=p, F_X=F)
plot(x,F,type="s",ylim=c(0,1),xlab="x",ylab="F_X(x)")
points(x,F,pch=19)
```
